cost_basis.provenance: PyPSA-Eur c8209014 tutorial uses technology-data v0.15.0; its config.yaml declares eur_year: 2025, with costs loaded in EUR by the upstream electricity build.
assumptions: EUR 2025 technology assumptions for the 2050 planning horizon, not observed 2013 electricity prices; currency year differs from weather year and planning year.
Capital costs are annualised and scaled to the objective-weighted horizon; dispatch-only GridStorm freezes capacities and excludes investment costs.
VOLL is a user-selected penalty in EUR/MWh on this basis, not a calibrated economic estimate.

name: PyPSA-Eur Belgium tutorial (5 clusters, 2013-03-01..07, 24 h)
description: Reduced PyPSA-Eur electricity-only model of Belgium built from the upstream tutorial configuration: OSM-based transmission grid clustered to 5 buses, conventional and renewable generators, battery/H2 storage, one week of March 2013 at daily resolution.

units.capital_cost: EUR per nominal MW (power) or MWh (Store energy), annualised then scaled to the model horizon

missing_value_policy: Values PyPSA-Eur does not provide are null in canonical.json; nothing is imputed by GridStorm. The synthetic BE load has no gaps in the 168 h window (checked by replace_load.py).
quality_flags: Load is the Interannual Electricity Demand Calculator BE series (temperature-regression model on ERA5 2013 weather, Zenodo 10820928) averaged to 24 h and split across buses with the upstream JRC Energy Atlas keys; the upstream ENTSO-E/OPSD load was removed.
Snapshots are 24 h averages; intra-day peaks are smoothed out.
Capital-cost-bearing extendable components: a plain n.optimize() is a capacity-expansion LOPF, not a dispatch run.
NUTS 2021 (GISCO) boundaries shaped the clustering and potentials indirectly; their download provisions exclude commercial use (no NUTS geometry is stored).
technology-data v0.15.0 cost assumptions: CC-BY-4.0 per the PyPSA-Eur data inventory, GPL-3.0 on the Zenodo release record.

transformations.description: pipelines/pypsa-eur/build.sh: snakemake results/test-elec/networks/solved_2050.nc with config/test/config.electricity.yaml; resources/test-elec/networks/composed_2050.nc taken before solving.

Removed the upstream ENTSO-E Power Statistics/OPSD BE load (not redistributable). loads_t.p_set[snapshot, bus] = mean of the 24 hourly synthetic BE values in [snapshot, snapshot + 24 h) x the bus's upstream JRC Energy Atlas share (time-invariant p_set / national total of the input network). Source: https://zenodo.org/records/10820928/files/demand_hourly.csv (doi:10.5281/zenodo.10820928, CC-BY-4.0, 464620414 bytes).
